How to play Kalmia Mission Control
StartMapMini-gamesCards & quizKeys & XPFAQ

Learn Class 13 by playing — in five minutes

Kalmia Mission Control turns tonight's lecture into four missions: cost versus benefit, continuity (backups, BCP (business continuity plan), DRP (disaster recovery plan)), residual risk and acceptance, and the $20,000 workshop. Each mission starts from a question, lets you build the answer with Kalmia's real numbers, then checks what you learned.

1Open the game file in a browser
2Click a mission on the map
3Why? → Build it → Cards → Quiz
4Collect stars, XP and badges
1

Open the map, pick a mission

  • Open Class13_Game_Kalmia_Mission_Control.html in Chrome, Edge or Firefox — no installation, no Internet needed except for the videos.
  • The map shows four missions, one per lesson. Click a circle to enter it.
  • Stars above a mission: Why?, Build it, Cards and Quiz completed (four stars turn the circle gold).
💡 You can play the missions in any order; following 1 → 4 matches the lecture.
⬇ Download this GIF
2

Stage 1 — Why? (first principles)

  • Read the question, press Why?: the answer appears and the next question opens.
  • Four whys lead from Kalmia's problem to the idea of the lesson.
  • The last answer unlocks the concept of the mission (+30 XP (experience points)).
💡 Before pressing Why?, say your own answer out loud — then compare.
⬇ Download this GIF
3

Stage 2, Mission 1 — Break-even Lab

  • Choose a risk, then move the sliders: factor on the ARO (annualized rate of occurrence) or the EF (exposure factor), one-time and yearly cost.
  • Watch ALE (annualized loss expectancy) before, ALE after, the annual cost, the net benefit and the ROSI (return on security investment) change live.
  • Below, decide like the CEO (chief executive officer): applicable, applicable only with a condition, or not applicable. Four right decisions earn the badge.
💡 A positive ROSI (return on security investment) is not enough for a HIGH or CRITICAL risk: the level rule comes first.
⬇ Download this GIF
4

Stage 2, Mission 2 — Survive 02:10

  • Step 1: click every copy that survives the attack, then Check my choice.
  • Step 2: choose the copy to restore from — the newest clean copy gives the smallest RPO (recovery point objective).
  • Step 3: click an action, then the plan it belongs to (incident response, DRP (disaster recovery plan) or BCP (business continuity plan)). Step 4: move the slider to test the restore time against the 24 h target and the 48 h tolerance.
💡 Offline or immutable copies survive; anything the attacker can reach is encrypted.
⬇ Download this GIF
5

Stage 2, Mission 3 — Who signs?

  • Each card shows a risk: its level today and its residual level after the Class 12 plan.
  • Click a card, then the right decision: owner, owner + CEO (chief executive officer), reduce first, or not acceptable.
  • Ten correct routings out of twelve earn the Signature authority badge.
💡 Residual HIGH or CRITICAL is never accepted by an owner; a MEDIUM risk with a low-cost control left is reduced first.
⬇ Download this GIF
6

Stage 2, Mission 4 — Budget Boss

  • Tick or untick measures; the cost, the expected loss and the residual levels recalculate.
  • Use Load the Class 12 plan or Load the auto-proposal as a starting point.
  • Win: within $20,000 and no residual HIGH or CRITICAL. ★★ under $35,000 of expected loss; ★★★ with every dependency in place.
💡 A plan that wins the game still needs written reasons for the rules it leaves open (insurance, function rule).
⬇ Download this GIF
7

Stages 5 and 6 — Cards and quiz

  • Cards: click the card or press the space bar to flip it; arrows move. Flip all cards of a mission for a star.
  • Quiz: an MCQ (multiple-choice question) needs one click; an MSQ (multiple-select question) shows how many answers to select — for example (select 3) — then press Submit.
  • Every option explains why it is right or wrong. The quiz is practice only and is not graded.
💡 Use the hint before answering, not after.
⬇ Download this GIF
8

Lecture, slides, codex and links

  • 3 · Lecture: the text of the lesson; each ▣ button opens the matching slide. 4 · Slides + notes: every slide with its notes.
  • Top bar: 📖 Codex searches every abbreviation and key term; 🖼️ Slides shows all 57 slides; ↗ Links lists the official sources and the videos.
  • Each link has a VirusTotal check link next to it.
💡 Your XP (experience points) and badges stay in this browser only. “Reset my progress” on the map starts again.

Questions students ask

Is the game graded? No. It is practice. Quiz 4 (Monday, November 23, 2026) is a separate assessment.

Do I need the Internet? Only to watch the videos and open the official links. Everything else works offline.

Where is my progress saved? In your browser (local storage). Another browser or a private window starts at zero.

Can I use the numbers in Lab 4? Yes: they are the same Kalmia numbers as the lecture and the workbook. Write your plan and your justifications in your own words (Legal Notice, section 18).
